info.title: BlueAnt CRM ERP API
info.description:
Enterprise CRM & Sales Management System

Features:
• Authentication & Authorization
• User & Role Management
• Lead Management
• Follow-up Management
• Meeting Management
• Client Onboarding
• CRM Operations
• Transaction Management
• Dashboard & Reports
• Notification Services
